immediate_action.label: Priority 1 — Act within 4 hours
criteria: Signed lease + identified budget + 50+ staff + professional services
Active tender or RFQ with a deadline
Referral from an existing TCD client
Project value >$150,000 with confirmed decision-maker contact

high_priority.label: Priority 2 — Act within 24 hours
criteria: Clear expansion signal but no confirmed budget yet
Warm enquiry with timeline under 3 months

deprioritise.label: Deprioritise or pass
criteria: No verifiable company name or business registration
Overseas entity with no Australian operations
Enquiry with no contact details or vague message

companySize.description: Staff count — 50+ = 20 pts, 20–49 = 12 pts, 10–19 = 6 pts, under 10 = 2 pts

projectValue.description: Estimated project value — >$200k = 25 pts, $100–200k = 18 pts, $50–100k = 12 pts, <$50k = 6 pts

expansionSignals.description: Strength of buying signals — signed lease = 20 pts, hiring surge = 15 pts, headcount mention = 10 pts, vague = 3 pts

budgetClarity.description: Budget mentioned and realistic = 15 pts, budget mentioned vague = 8 pts, no budget mentioned = 0 pts

industryFit.description: Law/finance = 20 pts, tech/professional services = 16 pts, engineering/healthcare = 12 pts, retail/other = 6 pts, residential = 0 pts

scoreInterpretation.5–7: Medium Priority — nurture with regular touchpoints
scoreInterpretation.1–4: Low Priority — add to email sequence only

qualificationQuestions: How many staff are relocating or will be accommodated in the new space?
Do you have a confirmed move-in date or a target date for completion?
What is the approximate budget you have allocated for furniture?
Are you working with an interior designer or architect on this project?
Who else is involved in making this decision?
